title: Personal Narrative of Capt. Jack Johnson, 2nd Platoon, UTT/68th Aviation Company
citation: Personal Narrative of Capt. Jack Johnson's Experience as Platoon Leader of the 2nd Platoon, Raider 26, 22 pp. Richard (Dick) Detra Collection, association 188th Assault Helicopter Company Association, Vietnam Center and Sam Johnson Vietnam Archive, Texas Tech University, item 0690504006.
notes: A platoon leader's account of the same unit and period. Places the Second Platoon 'working out of Tay Ninh covering a Special Forces Unit working through the jungle west of Nui Ba Den Mountain', and describes night missions reconnoitring the base of the mountain in support of Special Forces.
